title: Direct polarisation-state reconstruction with a temporal pointer: accessible states, resolution and optimal coupling
summary: Weak measurements are used to amplify small signals, to address foundational questions, and to characterise quantum states without tomography. In direct state reconstruction each amplitude of the state vector is proportional to a single complex weak value, which for a temporal pointer is read from the mean arrival time and the mean frequency of the postselected pulse.
